summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-cent (1%) City of Hercules sales tax expected to raise about $4 million per year for general city services including emergency response, police, water quality, and street repair.

tax.text: Yes on Measure P supports raising the Hercules sales tax by one cent to sustain city services and prevent cuts to programs like street maintenance and neighborhood crime prevention.
tax.quote: residents favored continuing neighborhood crime prevention, attracting businesses and preventing cuts to street maintenance.
